title: michaelschiltz.github.io — source of the personal academic website of Michael Schiltz
description:
Jekyll source of michaelschiltz.github.io: publications, projects, datasets, research notes, and a bookshelf of works read. Each deposit is a snapshot of the site's source at a release; the live site is the GitHub repository.

Site content is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (LICENSE-CONTENT). The al-folio theme code is MIT-licensed, copyright Maruan Al-Shedivat (LICENSE).
